title: Radial Shell, Altitude, and Effective-Potential Mapping
negative_results: an unknown radial profile key is refused
a radial profile with a non-source claim class is refused (labels are nonliteral)
a radial profile with a non-positive band_width is refused
a radial value mapping outside the [0, 8] shell range is refused
a mapping without a body_id is refused
shell_to_radial refuses altitude_in_band outside [0, 1] and a non-zero altitude for shell 0
refuse_effective_potential_as_physical() always raises: effective potential is a nonliteral label, not a physical potential
the 8 <-> 0 closure is refused by default and resolves only with an explicit apply_closure=True opt-in

claims.statement: A radial coordinate maps reversibly to a shell band and within-band altitude under four declared radial conventions (surface, atmosphere, orbit, dimensionless), reusing the shell registry.
'Effective potential' is a nonliteral SOURCE-ontology re-expression of the shell ordinal and is never a physical potential.
The 8 <-> 0 shell closure remains opt-in and is never silently applied (System Contract invariant 8).
